biotools.summary: Pipeasm is a Snakemake-based, Singularity-containerized workflow for automated chromosome-scale genome assembly and evaluation, processing HiFi, ONT, and Hi-C data through read trimming, nuclear and mitogenome assembly, scaffolding, decontamination, and quality assessment.
